plans.idea: Banner read left to right: one bold line spans most of the width at much larger type than the engine's version, with the orange brand line tucked tight beneath it on a shared centre axis, and even breathing room above and below.

Editorial left-aligned stack: the headline breaks into two big lines, 'Sparkle slowly.' over 'Sip at sunset.', with the brand line flush-left under them, all anchored to the left margin, while the dark open field to the right gives a calm sunset feel.

Faithful to the original: a narrower centred column wraps the headline into two centred lines with the brand line below, giving the square's centred stack in banner form at the largest type the height allows.
